title: Mumbai DCPs Meet Raj Thackeray Ahead of Sunday's MNS-Sena Victory March
summary: On [Date], Mumbai Deputy Commissioners (DCPs) met with Raj Thackeray, the chief of the Shiv Sena UBT, at Dadars Shivaji. The meeting comes ahead of a planned victory march by the MNS and Shiv Sena UBT on Sunday. The march is in support of NEET student protesters who died during the protests. The DCPs are expected to provide security for the march. The meeting was also attended by other officials from the MNS and Shiv Sena UBT.

framing_hi.right: वामपंथी समाचारों ने मीटिंग को राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा चिंता के रूप में पेश किया, जिसमें एनडीए और सुरक्षा बनाए रखने के लिए डीसीपी की भूमिका को उजागर किया।
